messages:
Maya: Heads up - Eastwell security sent a short vendor risk list before POC starts Tue. They want: DPA + SCCs, confirmation we don't train on customer data, DSAR timing, deletion API example, and export-on-termination window. Can we cover these today? @Tom @Ibrahim

Tom: I can handle infra. We'll run the POC in eu-west-1 and enable workspace-level isolation. Question: do we have flexibility to shorten inference-log retention for trials?

Ibrahim: Quick answers: standard hosted retains request metadata 30 days; we can configure trials to 7 days but backups may remain up to 30 days unless contracted otherwise. We do not use customer content to train models. For embeddings: by default vector persistence is off; if enabled, vectors are stored and removable via API.

Lina (Legal): Our DPA + SCCs bundle includes a clause prohibiting use of customer data for model training. DSARs: we verify and respond within 30 days; we can contractually commit to 30 days for hosted. Export window on termination: standard offer is 90 days for hosted; can be adjusted for Dedicated.

Ben (Compliance): SIG/CAIQ quick bullets: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+, SOC2 Type II available, MFA + RBAC for console, KMS for key control, annual pen test, monthly vuln scans. Breach notif: 72 hours. I'll prep the prefilled questionnaire.

Maya: Can we surface a simple curl they can run during POC to test deletion flow? Buyer wants to try it live.

Ibrahim: Example (admin-only):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/data/delete
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"workspace_id":"eastwell-poc","scope":"inference_logs"}'
```
Response includes job_id; deletion completes per SLA.

Tom: I'll default vector-store=off for the trial and note that enabling persistence requires explicit approval.

Lina (Legal): Uploaded DPA/SCCs and sub-processor attestation to internal drive: https://redwood.internal/pack/dpa_sccs_2025. I'll add a redline with a 90-day export clause and the training prohibition clause highlighted.

ProvisionBot: Provisioned workspace eastwell-poc-77 (eu-west-1). Lease rwd-9120. Assigned: Maya, Tom.

Maya: Great. Tom, Ibrahim, Ben: can we have the prefilled SIG + the deletion API example and the DPA link to the buyer by EOD? I'll draft the outbound.

Ben (Compliance): On it - SIG prefill ready in 3 hours.

Ibrahim: Deletion example and config notes done.

Lina (Legal): Sent DPA link to Maya and uploaded redline.

Maya: Thanks all. I'll send buyer the materials and confirm POC start on Tue. :thumbsup:
